content_sections.heading: About DLRL
content_sections.text: Defence Electronics Research Laboratory is a DRDO laboratory under the Ministry of Defence, located at Chandrayangutta Lines, Hyderabad. The Consultant is wanted for specific work on Software Quality Assurance (SQA), verification and validation, and software testing of software products developed by the laboratory, including software for its EW systems.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Interested eligible retired officials of Central Government, State Government, PSU or autonomous bodies may submit their applications in the enclosed format at Annexure II, along with copies of the documents referred to in the application. The postal address given in the notice is: The Director, Defence Electronics Research Laboratory, Government of India, Ministry of Defence, Defence Research & Development Organization, Chandrayangutta Lines, Hyderabad - 500 005. The notice does not mention the postal mode, any wording for the envelope or an email address for applications. Its cut-off is for receipt of the application, so the application must reach the address by the cut-off.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: One post is advertised: Consultant, Post Code 2026/DLRL/362, category Technical, for a retired official of pay level Level-13A. The contract duration printed in the post table is one year and extendable as per norms. Officers/officials who have retired from Central/State Government/PSUs/autonomous bodies/Govt. R&D organisations, with practical knowledge and experience in the field for which they apply, as per the Terms of Reference. Experience in software development process, software quality assurance and independent verification and validation activities, and testing of DLRL EW systems. Knowledge of DO-178 B/C and DGSD is mandatory. Effective communication (oral and written) and interpersonal skills, with a strong flair for in-depth examination of own areas of work. Experience of having worked with DRDO is accorded preference during selection/appointment. A gap of fifteen (15) days is required between retirement and appointment as Consultant. content_sections.heading: DLRL Consultant Job Description
content_sections.text: The Terms of Reference (Post Code 2026/DLRL/362, category of work: Technical; domain: Software quality assurance and Independent Verification and validation) list these objectives and tasks. Use knowledge of the software development process and standards and guidelines (DO-178B/C, DGSD, IEEE-12207) for SQA and independent verification and validation of critical electronic systems and software of DLRL for EW systems. Conduct reviews of software development life cycle documentation as per standards and guidelines. Test EW software products to comply with functionality and certification requirements. Verify and audit activities such as configuration management and version control management. Generate relevant information for the software quality assurance plan (SQAP). Guide the work on SQA, verification and validation activities as per standards and guidelines. Collaborate in reviewing SDLC documentation as per the baselined SQAP. Guide the generation of test cases and verify their necessity and sufficiency against software requirements. Collaborate in functional testing and performance testing of software products. Guide the verification and audit of IV&V Policy and Q&R Policy. The estimated time for completing the tasks is 2 years. The initial appointment may be for one year, with further extension up to two years with the approval of the Competent Authority.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested photocopies of these documents are to be enclosed by the applicant: Identity Proof Proof of address Copy of Pension Payment Order Copy of Proofs of Educational Qualification Copy of service Verification Certificate The Annexure II proforma asks for the name in block letters, date of superannuation, designation and pay at superannuation, last organisation served, date of birth, age as on the closing date, gender, correspondence address, email ID and contact numbers, education qualifications (graduation onwards), areas of research/specialization, a service record, published books/papers (for Scientific/Technological posts only), knowledge of computers and any other relevant information.

faq.question: Q1. How many Consultant posts has DLRL announced?
faq.answer: The notice announces one Consultant post, Post Code 2026/DLRL/362, in the Technical category, for a retired official of Level-13A.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the DLRL Consultant post?
faq.answer: The notice gives the cut-off for receipt of application as 21 days from the date of publication of the advertisement, which is about 02 December 2026 (21 days from 11 November 2026).

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the DLRL Consultant post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all categories of retired employees is 63 years as on the closing date of application.

faq.question: Q4. What is the pay of the DLRL Consultant?
faq.answer: A non-pensioner gets a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 60000/- per month plus conveyance allowance of Rs. 5000/- per month. Pensioners and NPS retirees get a fixed amount worked out by the formulas in the notice.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the DLRL Consultant post?
faq.answer: Submit the application in the Annexure II format with self-attested copies of the required documents to The Director, Defence Electronics Research Laboratory, Chandrayangutta Lines, Hyderabad - 500 005.

faq.question: Q6. Who can apply for the DLRL Consultant post?
faq.answer: Retired officials of Central Government, State Government, PSUs, autonomous bodies and Govt. R&D organisations with practical knowledge and experience in the field of the Terms of Reference can apply. Knowledge of DO-178 B/C and DGSD is mandatory.

faq.question: Q7. How is the pay of a retired pensioner fixed?
faq.answer: The fixed monthly amount is the pay drawn at the time of retirement minus the basic pension. It stays unchanged for the term of the contract, with no annual increment or percentage increase.

faq.question: Q8. Is the DLRL Consultant post permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a short term contract. The post table gives the duration as one year and extendable as per norms, and the engagement is of a temporary (non-Official) nature.

faq.question: Q9. Can a Consultant draw pension and other allowances?
faq.answer: A retired Govt. official continues to draw pension and dearness relief on pension, if eligible. Consultants are not entitled to Dearness Allowance, Residential Accommodation, CGHS or Medical reimbursement, but get TA/DA for official travel inside the country.

faq.question: Q10. Is there a gap required between retirement and joining as Consultant?
faq.answer: Yes. No retired government official is eligible unless there is a gap of fifteen (15) days between retirement and appointment as Consultant.
